name: Authentication
description: Verifies a customer's identity when signing in and provides authenticated access to the application.

name: Session Management
description: Maintains authenticated customer sessions across the application and controls session state after login.

name: Payment Authorization
description: Authorizes customer payments and verifies the customer before a payment is completed, including biometric verification such as Face ID or fingerprint authentication.

name: Payment Retry
description: Allows a failed or interrupted customer payment to be attempted again.

name: Order Creation
description: Creates a customer order after the required purchase and payment flow has been completed.

name: Notifications
description: Sends customer notifications such as order confirmations and other updates after relevant application events.

name: User Profile
description: Manages customer profile information such as account details and profile data.

name: Reporting
description: Provides business reporting and dashboard capabilities, including revenue reports and reporting data.
